page.overview:
Who is Portifoy?

Portifoy was the bodyguard of Cyprian Io.

Portifoy was a member of a gang of kidnapped by a gang of Opeeachean thugs who captured Cyprian Io. Io negotiated with Portifoy and convinced him to betray the others and return him to his home. Portifoy was rewarded by being appointed as Cyprian's bodyguard.

Portifoy stood guard by Io when he was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. Io ordered Portifoy to remove them from his sight, but rescinded the order when he considered the lecture that his grandmother, Orilis Io, would give him.
